scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:deploy: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix backend && npm run test:unit --prefix frontend
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run test:watch --prefix backend" "npm run test:watch --prefix frontend"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix backend && npm run test:coverage --prefix frontend
